contract: whole-document OCR fallback after the existing any(nonempty native text) decision

cases.input: 3-page native PDF with one empty middle page
cases.expected: native, no OCR invocation; all original 1-based page numbers and empty result retained

cases.input: image-only multilingual 3-page PDF with empty middle page
cases.expected: actual OCR, all pages processed in original order, document nonempty, empty page result retained without blank classification

cases.input: native first page plus scanned image second page
cases.expected: native for whole document; scanned body is an accepted missing-content boundary

cases.input: scan with extractable page number
cases.expected: native; no OCR; missing scanned body is explicitly reported as an accepted boundary

cases.input: all pages empty after actual OCR
cases.expected: stable no-text failure, no successful Version

cases.input: malformed PDF
cases.expected: pdf_invalid_or_encrypted, no OCR, no successful Version

cases.input: password-protected PDF
cases.expected: pdf_invalid_or_encrypted, no OCR, no successful Version

cases.input: valid PDF container with no pages
cases.expected: explicit zero-page failure, no OCR, no successful Version

cases.input: server counts PDF GETs and returns the exact fixture bytes
cases.expected: one GET per URL; archived original and attachment API SHA256 equal source bytes

cases.input: zero-exit child returning malformed JSON, oversized output, wrong count/index, missing page, page error, all-empty text
cases.expected: failure, no partial or successful Version, bounded output capture

cases.input: controlled child exits nonzero or emits stdout/stderr flood
cases.expected: stable process/output failure, no retry, no Version, bounded evidence

cases.input: OCR completes after page_timeout but before OCR total and collection budget
cases.expected: success; page_timeout does not cut off admitted OCR

cases.input: child and descendant ignore TERM past independent total deadline
cases.expected: deadline includes launch and validation, process group force-killed and reaped, workdir removed, no Version

cases.input: OCR deadline exceeds remaining collection budget
cases.expected: earliest monotonic deadline wins; no late Version

cases.input: more than four independent PDF OCR jobs in one run
cases.expected: peak OCR children <=4, event loop remains responsive, waiting consumes collection budget

cases.input: cancel while waiting for admission
cases.expected: no additional child starts after cancellation or exhausted budget

cases.input: cancel while OCR and descendant run
cases.expected: cancel propagates; process group reaped; cleanup cannot be interrupted; no late Version

cases.input: capturable normal application exit while OCR runs
cases.expected: same bounded process-group cleanup path; no successful Version

cases.input: child output and cancellation become ready together
cases.expected: cancel/deadline rejects late result and successful Version

cases.input: cancellation during process creation
cases.expected: owned process group cleaned and reaped; no orphan or Version

cases.input: exit/reap or workdir cleanup cannot be confirmed
cases.expected: explicit failure, fail-closed admission, no early release or deletion of in-use directory

cases.input: child environment and filesystem observations
cases.expected: PDF and frozen config only; no database/S3 credential inheritance; temporary files under root work

cases.input: parent SIGKILL, machine power loss, container runtime guarantees
cases.expected: outside instantaneous-cleanup promise; clearly marked UNVERIFIED
